activity_summary: After Errors, in which you played Egeon, the sharers reckoned the week. Your part was thirty-five shillings, received. You will not write a coffer under it. Last Saturday was thirty-eight, and this one is not a quarrel with that one. Wednesday's eightpence stays entered. The hired men stay at ten shillings. Christmas stays a blank, with no date and no sum. Monday is the Navarre comedy, and you are in it. Thursday is the king again, and you are in it. Phillips said yesterday's morning is not done and not priced. You did not show the page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the share, refused a coffer, and kept the page unshown.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Stated the thirty-five, named Monday and Thursday, and called it no balance.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Told him to walk the figure home and to skip the page.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Kept this week distinct from last Saturday.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Refused the coat and the toast.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept Nick's morning unpriced and unfinished.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Refused a Christmas night and refused to turn the share into a balance.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Thirty-five shillings. Your part, of the company, for the week to today.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not write a sum beside a hope.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Monday is the Navarre comedy, and you are in it.
